name: signalbox
description: A live circuit board beside the chat: Claude sits in the middle, its tools are pins that light up as they are used, and file and shell work is wired into a release track read from git. Switches between a tall and a wide layout by itself.

stagingName.title: Name of the staging stage
stagingName.description: What the middle stop of the release track is called in your project, such as Staging, UAT or Preview.

stagingPath.title: Staging folder
stagingPath.description: A folder on the trunk whose newest commit means the staging stage was updated, such as public/uat. Left empty, the track shows what is uncommitted instead of a staging stop.

liveName.title: Name of the live stage
liveName.description: What the last stop of the release track is called, such as Live or Production.

trunkBranch.title: Trunk branch
trunkBranch.description: The branch your work is measured against, such as main, master or develop. Left empty, Signalbox asks the remote which branch is its default and falls back to main or master.
